title: slopbuckets config
description: Configuration for buckets.config.json, read by the slopbuckets CLI.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor autocomplete.

adapter.description: Language adapter the CLI uses to read the project.

root.description: Folder of the root bucket, relative to the project.

alias.description: Import prefix for every internal import.

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth of the bucket tree. The root bucket is level 0.

access.description: Which buckets may use code that originates in which other buckets. Without it, nothing is checked.

default.description: Outcome for an import that no deny or allow line matches. When several lines match, the most specific one decides.

allow.description: Lines "A -> B": code in bucket A may use code that originates in bucket B. Under "default": "allow", an allow line opens an exception inside a deny line.

deny.description: Lines "A -> B": code in bucket A may not use code that originates in bucket B.

items.description: A line is two globs over bucket paths joined by "->", such as "root/api/** -> root/log". Each side starts with the root path or with "**". "**" matches zero or more buckets, "*" any characters inside a name, and "{a,b}" one of the alternatives.
